summary: Iteration 3 acceptance: (A) BUGFIX max_trades_per_day=0 semantics, (B) fee guard V3 with CRV relax, (C) manual lesson approval endpoint + UI button, (D) ai_manage default off in strategy trade settings, (E) new NumInput number-field UX. No writes to production Mongo (only GET + auth login + one 404 POST with fake key).

critical_code_review_comments: rules_text (services/ai_master_prompt.py) now renders limits with explicit '0 = kein Limit, KEINE Deaktivierung' – prevents any LLM from misreading 0 as 'off'. Clean fix at the correct layer (prompt rendering, not raw dict).

routers/ai_governance.py set_master_prompt calls _rules_text(snap['rules']) so all downstream contexts use the same explicit text – no regressions in the returned /api/ai/master-prompt payload (rules dict still shipped for the UI).
core/defaults.py: ai_manage=False in DEFAULT_STRATEGY_OVERRIDE and DEFAULT_STRATEGY_COIN_CFG – safe default, verified live via GET /api/autotrade/strategy/scalping.
NumInput component behaviour verified on real page: empty field with grey placeholder = last valid value, blur without input restores value. Consistent with spec (~105 fields).

Minor: React console warns about invalid <span> child of some parent element ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of ...') in AI panel Lernen view – purely a hydration/style warning, no functional impact, but worth cleaning up.

Cosmetic: bundle.js emits many 'Failed to fetch' errors on first mount before session is ready (fetchSession/fetchNotif etc.). Non-blocking (session picks up on retry), but noisy. Consider guarding these fetches or swallowing the error in the initial 401/no-session case.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/tests/test_iter3_live_bugfix.py hits localhost:8001 and covers the 5 iter-3 acceptance endpoints. StrategyAutoTradeModal only shows the KI-TRADER/ai-manage block after mode is switched to LIVE or PAPER (mode=AUS collapses the body) – if you need to check the checkbox, first click sat-mode-paper or sat-mode-live locally (does not persist until Speichern). The AI panel opens via strategy-tab-ai_trader + edit-strategy-params-btn (requires admin login via admin-lock-button). Insights endpoint currently returns 17 lesson_candidates – do not approve any of them (production DB).
rca of the issue: Original bug: KI interpretierte max_trades_per_day=0 im Roh-Dict als Deaktivierung. Root cause = ai_governance.set_master_prompt gab das rohe rules-Dict in den LLM-Prompt. Fix: rules_text() rendert Limits jetzt IMMER explizit ('UNBEGRENZT (0 = kein Limit, KEINE Deaktivierung)'), ai_governance nutzt rules_text statt raw dict, day_risk-Status liefert null statt 0. Es gab NIE eine technische Sperre – check_day_rules(0,...) liefert weiterhin (True,'').
